import os
from authlib.integrations.requests_client import OAuth2Session

# This example uses Google's OAuth2 service.
# You would typically get these from environment variables or a configuration management system.
CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID")
CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET")
REDIRECT_URI = "http://localhost:8000/callback" # This must match a registered redirect URI in your Google Cloud project

# Google OAuth2 authorization and token endpoints
AUTHORIZATION_ENDPOINT = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
TOKEN_ENDPOINT = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"

# Define the scopes your application needs
SCOPES = ["openid", "email", "profile"]

# 1. Start the authorization flow
# Create an OAuth2Session instance
client = OAuth2Session(
    client_id=CLIENT_ID,
    client_secret=CLIENT_SECRET,
    redirect_uri=REDIRECT_URI,
    scope=SCOPES
)

# Generate the authorization URL and state parameter
authorization_url, state = client.create_authorization_url(AUTHORIZATION_ENDPOINT)
